mechanism: Bumetanide-induced electrolyte depletion (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) and volume depletion can potentiate ropinirole's orthostatic hypotension and increase CNS adverse effects; ropinirole may also inhibit bumetanide's natriuretic efficacy through dopaminergic mechanisms.
action: Monitor blood pressure closely, maintain electrolyte levels, assess for orthostatic symptoms, and consider dose adjustment of ropinirole if hypotension occurs; ensure adequate hydration and periodic electrolyte monitoring.
